title: Rust/Axum/Tokio backend core
objective: Modular-monolith Rust workspace (api, config, errors, telemetry, domain, db, auth, cache, messaging, rate_limit, networking, workers) with health/ready/version, JSON API, graceful shutdown, timeouts, request IDs, structured errors, tracing, body limits, secure headers.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build/test/clippy -D warnings/fmt pass for the workspace
GET /healthz, /readyz, /version and a JSON example respond correctly in integration tests
Graceful shutdown, request-id propagation, timeout and body-limit behaviour covered by tests
validation: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
